outline:
This course enables the students know the fundamental concepts in materials science, modern theory of solids, and semiconductor physics/Devices. The introduction of electronic devices and semiconductor processing used in the current semiconductor industry are also included.
(Course taught in English)
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Elementary Materials Science Concepts
3. Electrical  Conduction in Solids
4. Elementary Quantum Physics
5. Fundamentals of Semiconductor
6. Semiconductor Devices (LED and Solar Cell)
7. Materials processing and fabrication
assessment:
Midterm Exam: 40%
Final Exam: 40 %
Class Participation: 20% (Homework, Classwork, Attendance)
